system.description:
Restrained (Conditions): Speed 0. Disadvantage on its attacks and on Reflex saves; attacks against it have Advantage. Being grappled, webbed, netted or bound all count as Restrained (see Unarmed Combat & Grappling).

Lasts / ends early by: Until it breaks free (Strength or Dexterity check against the source's DC, as an action). Cutting the bonds, Dispel Magic.

Win the contest, and the target is Restrained: Disadvantage on their attacks, and attackers gain Advantage against them, until they break free (see Restrained; for a grapple the check is contested by the grappler's Strength).

Contest: both sides roll d20 + the stated attribute modifier; the higher total wins and ties go to the defender.

Press Use while Restrained: you roll Strength or Dexterity against the grappler's Strength, and a win ends Restrained.
